newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: KPN HAS 19.2 PERCENT OF TNT .
newsitem.headline: KPN HAS 19.2 PERCENT OF TNT .

text.p: Dutch postal and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) said on Tuesday it had increased its stake in takeover target TNT Ltd to 19.2 percent following the on-market purchase of more than 13 million shares during local trade.
KPN said its local unit KPN Australia had bought 13.25 million TNT ordinary shares, or 2.3 percent of the international transport firm's issued capital, at prices up to A$2.44 per share.

It also acquired 7.8 million TNT converting preference shares, representing 3.7 percent, at up to A$2.43 per share. KPN is now entitled to 19.2 percent of TNT's ordinary issued shares and 19.6 percent of the converting preference shares.
KPN has launched an agreed A$2.0 billion bid for TNT pitched at A$2.45 per share, which closes on November 19.
TNT's annual meeting will be held in Sydney on Wednesday.
